$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Date and time · day and exact slot

band.rule: Journey step: demotes when the step closes.

job: Choose a day, a part of the day and an exact time, with optional groups of times by audience. One step of a booking; nothing else from the booking lives here.
useFor: Timed entry with limited capacity per slot, with or without separate groups.
notFor: Day-level bookings (use Date and time · day and period). Prayer times display (PrayCard on Today).

allowed: Toolbar · Companion MGM: who the booking is for, edit the party, close.
forbidden: Toolbar · Timer when no place is held.
Hiding who the booking is for.

allowed: Full date title with previous day and next day.
Pray Card row: Selected On or Off, one On at a time.
Audience icons only together with a text label.
forbidden: Icons alone to name an audience.
Prayer times presented as bookable times.
A period with no slots shown as available.

allowed: Headers · 04 Legend: one line that names the window.
A headline per group and Time slot card in three columns: Default, Selected, Disabled; Available soon with its icon and a stated meaning.
forbidden: Selecting in two groups at once.
Icons in a slot corner with no stated meaning.

allowed: TabBar action bar · Actions: one line that repeats the chosen day and time, and one Primary that names the outcome.
forbidden: A disabled Primary as the only feedback.

interaction: Open on the first day that has places; no time is chosen for the person.
The month or date title opens Sheet - Calendar. Its Primary applies the day, Ghost closes it and keeps the current day.
Changing the day clears the chosen time and reloads the list; a day with nothing shows EmptyState and points to another day.
Changing the period keeps the day and reloads the slot groups.
Choosing a slot selects it alone across all groups; the card shows Selected and the action bar repeats day and time in words.
The Primary continues to the summary of the booking.
rules: The chosen slot is visible on the slot itself, not only in the action bar.
Disabled means full or closed; "Available soon" has a stated meaning and a time when known.
Groups follow the party in the toolbar; a group that does not apply is not shown.
The main action stays enabled; on tap it says what is missing (M10).
Slot targets are 48 dp high or more; digits 0–9; Arabic and English both checked.

allocation.App level: L3 · a configuration step inside a booking. Opened from the service page, never from Today.
allocation.Scarcity: Only when slots are truly limited: then a full or soon-open slot is stated plainly. It is information, never pressure.
allocation.Withheld: Booking control for Dependents and Organised groups is P0: they see the booked time, not this picker.

measure.success: Step completion and time to choose
measure.guardrails: changes after confirmation, cancellations, taps on disabled slots

allocation.Service: Rawdah Permits · DNA Core. Resting P3, raised to P1 at M1.2 (genuine scarcity, genuine push, T1).

notes: Built on Visit Details Master with Tabs off and List on, wrapped in a local component (Rawdah Visit Details).
Groups in the example: times for men and times for women.
Window line in the example: from midnight to Fajr.
example.inTheFlowToday: The "Slot Selected" screen shows no selected slot; only the action bar changes. The calendar sheet shows red dots under days with no stated meaning. The hint line carries %s. The main action is disabled until a slot is chosen. The sheet frame is named "Select data sheet".
